verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own AI Object Storage supports bucket lifecycle policies with Expiration and NoncurrentVersionExpiration actions, which gives users direct, configurable retention and deletion control over stored data such as training data, checkpoints and model weights. The evidence is a single changelog mention scoped to object storage, and nothing covers retention or deletion for other data. Missing for 10: retention/deletion controls beyond object storage (inference data, logs, telemetry, account-level data), detailed first-party docs on lifecycle configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Bucket lifecycle policies is the reference for supported lifecycle actions (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload)
